editorial:
Imagine you are a college student just trying to finish your big final project. You and your friends decide to visit a creepy old plantation house near New Orleans because you want to study old myths. The problem is that everyone who goes there ends up dead or completely insane. You get the feeling right away that the group is walking into a trap, but they are too curious to stop. The movie sets up a spooky mood where the house itself feels like it is watching you, making you feel uneasy from the very first scene.

While the acting is mostly okay, the real draw here is how the tension builds up as the friends start losing their minds. Some parts move a bit slow, but the scares make up for it. If you like movies where people get trapped in a scary place, you will enjoy this one.
endingExplained: The movie ends with the realization that the house uses a dark curse to trap people. After most of the friends are killed or go crazy, the main character discovers that the estate feeds on the fear and souls of visitors. In the final moments, he tries to escape, but the house ensures that no one leaves unchanged. He ends up becoming part of the cycle of madness, proving that the legends about the plantation were true all along.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves haunted house stories and supernatural mysteries.
